shows.title: Patti LuPone - Matters Of The Heart
shows.description: Three-time Tony Award® winner PATTI LUPONE will perform her critically acclaimed theatrical concert MATTERS OF THE HEART at the London Coliseum on 14 & 15 February 2027.

shows.title: The Greatest Showman
shows.description: Don’t miss Oliver Tompsett and Samantha Barks in T*he Greatest Showman*, the new stage musical based on the hit 2017 film at Theatre Royal Drury Lane.

shows.title: Charlie and the Chocolate Factory
shows.description: Escape to a world of pure imagination with ROALD DAHL’S Charlie and The Chocolate Factory – The Musical.

shows.title: Mr Loverman
shows.description:
Some love last a lifetime. Some Secrets do too.
A story of love, family, and what it means to finally choose yourself, Mr Loverman spans six decades of life from Antigua to modern-day London.

shows.title: Suddenly Last Summer
shows.description:
Violet Venable is determined to protect the reputation of her late son Sebastian, but her niece Catharine has a different story about what happened last summer. 
Emma Corrin and Harriet Walter feature in Tennessee Williams' haunting masterpiece, directed by Michael Grandage.

shows.title: Samira
shows.description:
Sometimes only the truth can save us.
Thrilling, funny and provocative, Samira is a new play by Carmen Nasr (Under the Shadow), directed by Emily Burns (Dear Octopus).

shows.title: Major
shows.description: In the Olivier theatre, playwright James Graham (Dear England) and director Jeremy Herrin (People, Places & Things) reunite after the acclaimed This House and follow up with the world premiere of Major.

shows.title: West Side Story
shows.description: Winter 2027 Next winter, a major revival of the Broadway classic West Side Story will run in the Olivier theatre.

shows.title: Rosencrantz and Guildenstern Are Dead
shows.description: Closing the year in the Lyttelton theatre will be Deputy Artistic Director Robert Hastie’s (Summerfolk) new production of Tom Stoppard’s absurdist classic Rosencrantz and Guildenstern Are Dead.

shows.title: The Great Indaba
shows.description: The Great Indaba dramatises how the 1998 Good Friday Agreement started life at an extraordinary meeting in South Africa between the new National Unity Government led by Nelson Mandela and the bitter political rivals within Northern Ireland.

shows.title: Plenty
shows.description: Also in the Lyttelton theatre next year, former National Theatre Director Richard Eyre, will direct a new production of David Hare’s landmark, award-winning play, Plenty, which examines post-World War II disillusion through the life of ex-secret agent, Susan Traherne.

shows.title: Glorious Madness
shows.description: Spring 2027 Spring will see the world premiere of Glorious Madness, in a co-production with KPPL Productions, a new British musical with the songs (music and lyrics) of legendary Grammy and Brit Award-winning artist Joan Armatrading framed and heard anew within an original love story.

shows.title: Ghostlight
shows.description: The multi-award winning theatre company Punchdrunk, will mark 50 years of the National Theatre’s South Bank home with a new immersive production.

shows.title: The Adeymis - A Family Saga
shows.description: Winter 2027 Later in the year, British Nigerian writer Oladipo Agboluaje’s (New Nigerians) new political family drama The Adeyemis – A Family Saga will have its world premiere in the Dorfman theatre, with Lucian Msamati (Amadeus) making his National Theatre directing debut and three-time Emmy winning actor Uzo Aduba (Orange is the New Black) also making her National Theatre debut in the role of Helen.
